market.question: Will May 2026 be the 4th or lower hottest on record?

assessment.reasoning: May 2024 was warmest May, May 2025 second-warmest. May 2023 was likely third. La Niña conditions emerging may cool 2026 slightly. May 2026 could plausibly come in 3rd or 4th depending on margin. Cooling from 2024->2025 was only ~0.05C. Probability of falling outside top 3 is moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Magnitude of La Nina cooling effect on global May anomaly.
